description: Label merges applied to the ANNOTATION column before training and to ground-truth files before evaluation. Keys are raw labels, values are model classes; labels not listed are used as they are. A training run saves the copy it used, and prediction applies the copy in the model folder. The merges here join labels of an earlier naming of the classes; they match none of the labels of the released model's training data, whose labels already carried its class names. Edit this file, not the code, to change the class scheme.
